knownLimitations: The Government guide lists eight active postcodes but is not a current versioned complete assignment, alias, validity, correction, exception and non-area denominator.
Prose locality and post-office coverage is not Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry.
The Statistics Department open licence is expressly limited to its own data and does not establish Postal Service or Physical Planning reuse/public-serving rights.
The real MS API returned unsupported; no MS translucent fill, outline, geometry class, source, date or confidence was rendered.
No parish, locality, street, office, route, P.O. box, organization, address, building, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID cell or synthetic MSR code was promoted.
environmentNotes: Dependencies were restored from the existing npm cache with npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts; no network dependency retrieval or install script ran.

In-app Browser failed before navigation because its Windows sandbox could not apply deny-read ACLs; deterministic Playwright fallback was reported honestly as not a successful MS postal-area visual E2E.
The screenshot was fixed and hashed outside Git, but the local image-view helper returned Windows error 206 even for short temporary copies; visual inspection is not claimed.
